I mustered up and got the test done. Quite frankly, I think it was one of the best things I could’ve done during my visit to Pattaya. I mainly did the blood & urine test (7,999bht) for testosterone levels & prostate cancer. I think I got extremely lucky and my guardian angel was and still is taking care of me. I’m 57 and my T level was off the chart (1247 ). For those that are familiar, the normal levels of a 21 - 49 year old falls in between 300 to 1200 nanograms per deciliter (Ng/DL).

My prostate checked out good along with pretty much everything else except Cholesterol border high and barely low on Red Blood Cells. So with Dr. Cham’s advice, I am correcting those and should be good to go.

The obvious question was why I felt my T level was under performing and he explained a medicine I was taking (Finasteride), was blocking my T level performance. He recommended lowering in half my daily finasteride pill.

So, enough about me.

Dr Cham was so easy to talk to. Explained very well the results - takes about 40’ to 60’ min explaining. Price is 100% worth it regardless of what I consider are excellent results. His establishment is well run. Staff extremely polite and attentive.

I could go on with the compliments. I guess I can sum it up with saying this:

This could’ve easily been explained to me in the US twenty years ago.  Always thought I was low on T.  Paying ~ $875 a month for insurance and my doctor in US knew very well I was complaining about low performance to the extent I was prescribed sildenafil. If things could’ve just been explained to me, it would’ve saved relationships and grief.

Do yourself a favor and find out about your body and health overall. The list of things addressed through this exam is extensive and informative. Now it’s up to me to carry on and address any low results.

5 STARS!
Thank you Dr Cham and thank you to all your staff!
